decisions.reason: Keeping the conferencing option open is justified because it remains low-cost and demand uncertainty has not resolved, though competitive intensity keeps its withdrawal probability moderate.
The specific Hong Kong adoption validates the product's value and reduces uncertainty, so the option is maintained with a very low chance of withdrawal.
The service builds on established optical strengths and fits the high-bandwidth strategic direction, so the option remains valuable and is kept with low withdrawal risk.
Direct voice network connection faces declining demand and is no longer aligned with the firm's software-defined infrastructure path, so its option value does not justify continued investment.
